title: timerfind
summary: Find visible timer objects by exact property value.

gpu_support.notes: `timerfind` queries host-side timer handles and does not use acceleration providers.

description: `timerfind` returns valid timer handles whose `ObjectVisibility` is `on` and whose properties exactly match the supplied name-value filters.
behaviors: `timerfind` returns all visible valid timers in the current runtime thread.
`timerfind(Name, Value, ...)` applies exact property matches. Character rows are normalized to strings for matching.
A single match returns a scalar timer handle. Zero or multiple matches return a 1-by-N cell row because RunMat does not yet have first-class MATLAB object arrays.
Deleted timers are removed from discovery. Timers with `ObjectVisibility='off'` are omitted; use `timerfindall` to include invisible timers.
gpu_behavior: `timerfind` is host-side handle registry lookup and has no GPU behavior.
